entries.en: Where'd I hear that one before?
I'm serious. Heard it on TV!
Where the fuck you get a TV?
Window was open at the bar yesterday. Could hear the whole thing. Arasaka and Militech are beefin', war's comin'.
entries.ro: Ieri era geamul deschis la bar. Se auzea tot. Arasaka și Militech se iau la bătaie, vine războiul.

entries.en: And so what? Think they're gonna send you an AV, take you straight to the front line?
entries.ro: Și ce dacă? Crezi că-ți trimit un AV să te ducă direct pe front?

entries.en: Hahahah! Look at you. Nothin' but a bag of bones on two stanky legs. Nobody's gonna recruit that.
entries.ro: Hahahah! Uită-te la tine. Un sac de oase pe două picioare puturoase. Pe ăla nu-l ia nimeni.

entries.en: Nobody asked for your shit opinion, either. Took me once, they'll take me again.
entries.ro: Nimeni n-a cerut nici părerea ta de rahat. M-au luat o dată, mă iau și iar.
